title: 🐶 Playful, Cuddly & Curious Dogs Ready for Adoption in Holly Springs - NewsBreak
text:
7 hours ago These Holly Springs pups are hoping for a fresh start and a cozy couch to call their own. All are with Pawfect Match Rescue and Rehabilitation and looking for loving families.
Kiya Breed: American Pit Bull Terrier / Staffordshire Bull Terrier mix
Age: Young
Gender: Female
Color: Brown/Chocolate with White
Adoption fee: $400
Shelter: Pawfect Match Rescue and Rehabilitation
Why you’ll love Kiya:
Loves to cuddle and hang out on the couch Crate trained House trained Friendly girl who came up from Georgia and is loving her new foster home Kiya’s foster mom is happy to bring her to meet you—just reach out through the rescue to set up a visit.
👉 Meet Kiya and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Polly Breed: Boxer / Rhodesian Ridgeback mix
Age: Baby (about 8 weeks; est. DOB 7/26/2026)
Gender: Female
Color: Tan/Yellow/Fawn with Black
Adoption fee: $400
Shelter: Pawfect Match Rescue and Rehabilitation
Why you’ll love Polly:
Tiny “little nugget” rescued after being abandoned in a busy railyard Very sweet and people-friendly Young enough to grow up with your family and learn your routines Polly has already stolen hearts at the rescue and is ready for a safe, forever home.
👉 Meet Polly and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Harley (Planet mama) Breed: German Shepherd Dog / Shepherd (unknown type) mix
Age: Young
Gender: Female
Adoption fee: $400
Shelter: Pawfect Match Rescue and Rehabilitation
Harley is a young shepherd mix looking for a home that appreciates an active, intelligent dog. Details are limited on her listing, so the rescue can share more about her personality and needs once you inquire.
👉 Meet Harley and apply to adopt on adoptapet
